:::{#exm-reed-solomon-list-size}
#### The list-size bound for the length-5 code

<!-- no-figure: the example is one computed number -->

For the code with $n = 5$ and $k = 2$ of @exm-list-decoding-reed-solomon, take $e = 2$.
The bound of @thm-reed-solomon-list-size is $\binom{5}{2} / \binom{3}{2}$.

```{r}
#| label: reed-solomon-list-size
choose(5, 2) / choose(3, 2)
```

So every received word has at most 3 codewords within distance $2$,
since the number of codewords is a whole number.
The received word of @exm-list-decoding-reed-solomon has 2.

:::
